t: This is the site of Powis House, an eighteenth-century mansion that stood on the northern side of Great Ormond Street, not far from Queen Square. The house is gone now, but it matters here for one reason in the material I have: the architect William Willmer Pocock was born here. Pocock, who lived from 1813 to 1899, was a British architect. That is all I can say about him with confidence, so I'll leave it there and let you picture the mansion that once occupied this stretch of the street.
